results.title: Sapphire Arms RX 9070 XT With Valor Mortis Theme, Free Game Bundle, But Stays Silent On Pricing
results.description: Even when the GPU prices are soaring, we have some vendors releasing newer GPUs, which is great only if the prices are fair. The company has been announcing custom-themed AMD GPUs for a while now, and this new GPU is based on the upcoming RPG Soulslike RPG Valor Mortis, which is scheduled to release on October 13. results.title: Reggae Boyz squad named for opening Nations League games
results.description: Head Coach Rudolph Speid has named his Reggae Boyz squad for the first two games of their 2026-2027 Concacaf Nations League campaign. Jamaica, drawn in Group B, will open the first round at the National Stadium against Guatemala on Friday, September 25, before welcoming Honduras four days later on Tuesday, September 29. Speid has selected a 24-man squad for the assignment. It will see the return to the Reggae Boyz squad for a number of players who last represented Jamaica in the failed World Cup 2026 qualifying campaign. Among them are goalkeeper and captain Andre Blake, wingers Leon Bailey and Tyreece Campbell, defender Richard King, midfielders Kasey Palmer and Karoy Anderson, and forward Renaldo Cephas. The top two teams from the two Nations League preliminary groups will qualify for the finals where they will be drawn alongside the ranked teams- two-time defending champions Mexico, the USA, Canada and Panama in the quarterfinals. See the full Reggae Boyz squad below. Squad Goalkeepers Andre Blake (captain), Shaquan Davis, Amal Knight Defenders Ronaldo Webster, Christopher Ainsworth, Joel Latibeaudiere, Tayvon Gray, Richard King, Damion Lowe, Miguel Freckleton Midfielders Isaac Hayden, Kasey Palmer, Courtney Clarke, Karoy Anderson, Dwayne Atkinson, Leon Bailey, Brandon Cover Forwards Bailey-Tye Cadamarteri, Javon East, Renaldo Cephas, Tyreece Campbell, Rumarn Burrell, Kaheim Dixon, Andre Brooks

results.title: Asian Games 2026: India's cricket team in semis, teqball eyes bronze
results.description: India's women's cricket team stormed into the Asian Games 2026 semifinals with an eight-wicket win over Japan. The teqball mixed doubles pair of Quimcy Joaquim Dsouza and Mohamed Anas Imran Beg also secured a spot in the bronze medal match.
